svg.title: Coordinates are not rulers
svg.desc: A polar grid has an annular sector highlighted; its radial and angular edges have different measuring factors. For an infinitesimal cell, the angular edge is r dθ and the radial edge is dr. The finite cell is enlarged for visibility; the plane is intrinsically flat.

g.text: A flat plane, with polar labels
A grid can bend without the surface curving.
